shadow.name: --upload-shadow
shadow.raw: inset 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--upload-accent) 14%, transparent), 0 0 14px color-mix(in srgb, var(--upload-accent) 12%, transparent)

other.name: --store-shade
other.raw: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--background) 0%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 94%, transparent) 24%, color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 25%, transparent) 62%, transparent)

other.name: --upload-fill
other.raw: linear-gradient(125deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--upload-accent) 12%, var(--background)), var(--background) 65%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--upload-accent) 9%, var(--background)))

other.name: --live-glass
other.raw: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand-silver) 7%, var(--card)), var(--card) 70%)

other.name: --cinema-shade
other.raw: linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 92%, transparent), color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 48%, transparent) 48%, transparent 85%), linear-gradient(0deg, var(--background), transparent 65%)

other.name: --music-shade
other.raw: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in srgb, var(--background) 45%, transparent), color-mix(in srgb, var(--background) 90%, transparent) 55%, var(--background))

other.name: --music-detail-wash
other.raw: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--brand-silver) 8%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 75%, transparent) 65%, var(--background))

other.name: --reference-cover-shade
other.raw: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 15%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 30%, transparent) 45%, var(--background) 100%)

other.name: --welcome-glass
other.raw: linear-gradient(145deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--brand-silver) 6%, var(--background)), var(--background) 80%)

other.name: --welcome-shade
other.raw: linear-gradient(180deg, color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 40%, transparent), color-mix(in oklch, var(--background) 65%, transparent) 55%, var(--background))
